manifest.name: Users
manifest.description: User accounts, their global role and their role on each cluster. Administrators only.

actions.resetOwnHint: Change your own password from the user menu in the status bar.
actions.deleteOwnHint: You cannot delete your own account.

fields.roleHelp: Administrators manage users, clusters, plugins and the audit log, and have full access to every cluster.

create.title: Add user
create.description: The user signs in once with this password and then has to choose a new one.
create.usernameHelp: Letters, digits, '.', '_', '@' and '-'; up to 64 characters.
create.passwordHelp: At least {{count}} characters. Share it with the user over a safe channel.
create.done: User {{name}} added. They must change the password at their first sign-in.

errors.username: Enter 1 to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_', '@' or '-', starting with a letter or digit.
errors.taken: A user with this name already exists.
errors.password: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.

reset.title: Reset password of {{name}}
reset.description: {{name}} is signed out everywhere and has to choose a new password at the next sign-in.
reset.help: At least {{count}} characters. Share it with the user over a safe channel.
reset.done: Password of {{name}} reset. They must choose a new one at the next sign-in.

errors.password: The password needs at least {{count}} characters.

edit.title: Access of {{name}}
edit.accessHelp: Viewers can look at everything on a cluster; operators can also change resources and open shells. A read-only cluster blocks changes for everyone.
edit.adminAccess: Administrators have full access to every cluster. The roles below apply again if the user becomes a regular user.

errors.lastAdmin: At least one administrator must remain. Make another user an administrator first.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.message: The account, its sessions and its cluster assignments are removed. Audit log entries are kept.

errors.self: You cannot delete your own account.
errors.lastAdmin: The last administrator cannot be deleted. Make another user an administrator first.
